item.title: Kelsey Carter earns State FFA Degree
item.description: Montrose FFA wants to Congratulate Kelsey CarterKelsey Carter has officially earned her State FFA Degree, the highest degree awarded by the Missouri FFA Association.Through her dedication to FFA, her involvement in numerous organizations, and her consistent leadership, Kelsey has shown what it means to lead by example. Her hard work, perseverance, and passion for agriculture have set her apart. #MidAmericaLive
